name: Mazar of Bulleh Shah
evidence: Rafat prints "Bulleh Shah died in 1758." (p. 48, folio 28) and carries 1758 consistently across its date registers; Shackle's Pass 2 states the book prefers 1758 against the archive's 1757.
caveat: A THIRD value exists: schimmel_as_through_a_veil's index headword prints "Bullhe Shah (d. 1754)" (p. 351, folio 333). Two books agree on 1758, but the corpus offers three different years, so this is not unanimous.

name: Shrine of Fariduddin Ganjshakar
evidence: Kugle's Pass 2 flags it explicitly: book 1265 (p. 260, folio 239) against archive 1266. Rafat gives 1265 in all three of its date registers (pp. 25, 29, 30).
caveat: No third value in the corpus. Eaton's 1335 refers to Baba Farid's grandson and is not a conflict.
